svg.text: Every entity, its fields and its references. Arrows point from a child to its parent or target. Coloured “→” tags point into another domain. Dashed lines are “is a” subtypes sharing the parent’s uid.
folders hold the user’s files only
Owners and where each declaration comes from
Node: declared inputs and outputs (from its NodeType)
Effect: shader inputs except image (from its Shader)
Declarations (range, options, default) resolve through the owner.
Live values (LFO output, linked inputs) stay in the runtime.
Content clip (source = Graph or Media): renders its source,
runs its Effects in order, then composites onto the tracks below.
Effect clip (source = a filter Shader): processes the composite
of every track below it while the playhead is inside it.
Its shader inputs are Parameters owned by the Clip.
Blend: the clip’s mode wins unless it is Normal, else the track’s.
Clip time = (t − start) × speed, or t × speed when Continuous.
CuePoint: when the watched value rises above the condition,
the playhead jumps to the marker, even while paused.
HoldPoint: playback pauses for its duration, then continues.
Loop: with loop playback on, end jumps back to start.
Not attached to the Timeline yet (open decision).
Node positions, graph views, selection, playhead, loop toggle.
Kept outside the model. Node positions are saved with the project.
